name: CSO_C_BATCH_REQUEST
description: This table contains content batch requests.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: This is the channel id of the batch.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete Owner id of the batch.

columns.name: SITE_ID
columns.description: The site id of the batch for this record.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: The name of the batch for this record.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: A flag indicating SUCCESS or ERROR.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_RESOLUTION
columns.description: A flag to indicating the workflow resolution.

columns.name: OVER_WRITE_TYPE
columns.description: A flag to indicating the overwrite type.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This is the description of the batch.

columns.name: DATE_COMPLETED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the entire batch was completed.

columns.name: DATE_EXPORTED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the batch was exported.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the Owner id of the batch.
